name: project-launchdeck
description: Repository-owned VoyageWright Codex launches with full project/GitHub context, Project Trim contracts, standard titles, retry receipts, and safe fallback.

interface.longDescription: Launch an agreed initiative or phase directly into the VoyageWright Codex project when native host tools are available. Uses repository-owned Project Trim guidance and all relevant accessible project and GitHub sources. Applies standard titles, durable retry receipts, Goal requests and evidence checks, and cleanup of owned temporary relays. Provides a ready-to-launch prompt when native dispatch is unavailable. This plugin does not grant new host permissions or promise global exactly-once creation.
defaultPrompt: Launch the agreed phase as a Goal in the VoyageWright Codex project using Project Trim.
Prepare a compact implementation launch from our agreed scope and current repository evidence.
Check a previous Launchdeck request and reconcile its receipt before retrying.
